clause.title: Owned installation without seat charges
clause.gap: Settings covers campaigns, campaignCustomFields, deliverables, milestones, risks, decisions, savedLenses and automations only. Operator, session and lens-condition coverage and every other declared limit remain unproved, including selection, import, upload, request, public-rate, timeline and warehouse measurements and boundary matrices. Fresh own-account or Managed installation, R-12 receipts, SCALE-001 and SCALE-002 qualification and whole-clause judgment remain unclaimed. Ct contract conversion and generated-document synchronization remain release prerequisites.

clause.text: *Tier:* Core · *Cites:* BASE-INSTALL-001, BASE-DATA-005, BASE-DATA-001 · *Register:* R-12 **Requirement.** Cradle is MIT licensed and offers RER Managed hosting as an alternative installation path.
